prompt:
Create ONE production death animation sheet for the EXACT UNIQUE boss Girtas in the two supplied references. Do not close the pale face into a red V mask, do not replace the long dark skirt with segmented trousers, and do not replace the sinuous weapon with a broad short sword. This is original-faithful new action artwork, never a character redesign.

Author SIX distinct physical SOUTH-facing death poses, ordered LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM. The fixed camera is the same game isometric camera throughout. SOUTH means TOWARD THE VIEWER, screen DOWN: in the first upright poses we see the original FACE and FRONT chest/waist, with the head pointing towards the bottom of the screen. Keep SOUTH heading while collapsing. The fall is FORWARD TOWARDS THE VIEWER along the screen-down axis, not sideways screen left or right, and not a turn to north/rear. In the final forward-fallen corpse the HEAD is toward SCREEN BOTTOM and FEET trail toward SCREEN TOP. The corpse lies on the ground, strongly foreshortened along this south/down axis; its upper back can naturally become visible as the same south-facing body bends forward, without turning around. Do not draw a sideways east/west corpse. The weapon stays on its original anatomical right-hand side, viewer-left in the upright poses, with its full sinuous blade contour retained through the fall. The narrow golden back-spine array remains attached to the upper back and tips forward with the torso, then lies in the fallen body's plane; never leave a standing halo after the body falls. No extra arms, legs, blades or detached spines.

Golden spines, hair and skirt are fully visible and correctly attached, weapon still on its same hand side. A true falling anatomy, not an upright sprite shifted downward.

Body is LOW AND GROUNDED along the south axis, full golden spike array tilted flat with back, full weapon settles beside its original right hand. Hair and skirt spread naturally on impact.

The exposed pale head/hair, two arms, full dark long skirt, two boots, all physical golden back spines and ENTIRE original sinuous weapon are present and uncropped.
